name: Flamethrower
role: held / pickup / icon model of the Flamethrower (a stream weapon, crafted at the train's bench or bought at a Market gun stall; not a weapon-variety identity, never a find)
approval: task-specific user generation grant 63caa2a0-d8b5-44c0-9b69-fa4eb22585e2 (a scoped cap of 75 Meshy credits); this model: 15 credits, the first attempt of its design image
route: Codex native image_gen INITIAL design image (a strict side view: shoulder rest at the left, burner bell at the right) -> Meshy T2.5 image-to-3D (smart topology, 2K PBR); the Meshy model keeps its own PBR maps (re-encoded only)

conditioningImage.generator: Codex CLI built-in image_gen (ChatGPT login); image model id not reported
conditioningImage.note: the INITIAL design image (kept outside Git): a reference only, not an input of this cook

meshy.evidence: the exact create arguments, the charge, the price evidence and the raw hash are in the job ledger kept outside Git

source.kind: the Meshy raw original: kept outside Git, read-only and never shipped
source.axes: the burner bell at -X, +Y up, the weapon's right side (the design image's visible side) facing -Z

weld.rule: exact-attribute weld (bitwise-equal position / normal / uv), degenerate triangles and unreferenced vertices dropped: lossless

processing.simplify: none: the model's triangle count is kept (held-weapon first-person density)
processing.rotation: rotateY(-90deg): (x, y, z) -> (-z, y, x); raw -X (the burner bell) -> game -Z, raw -Z (the design image's visible = the weapon's RIGHT side) -> game +X

orientationCheck.rule: the front (-Z) end band must be >= 0.1 m wide (the bell) and the rear end band <= 0.07 m (the shoulder rest)

processing.lengthRule: uniform scale so the overall Z extent (shoulder rest to the bell's mouth) = 0.95 m: a two-handed burner lance; the bell is then 125 mm across, the heat shield 50 mm, the rear grip sleeve 31 mm
processing.origin: the bounding box centred on the origin

ops.why: a stray thread of long sliver triangles between the hose's end fitting and the centre of the front handle's foot (a reconstruction artefact that reads as a wire under the weapon)
ops.rule: the triangles lying wholly inside the box min [-0.006,-0.1125,0.03] max [0.006,-0.1065,0.152] (m) whose Z extent exceeds 0.02 m
ops.note: whole triangles removed; nothing cut, moved or added (a ~3 x 11 mm opening stays on the underside of the hose fitting, where the spike left it); UVs / maps untouched

Grip.rule: the bounds centre of the rear rubber grip sleeve: the largest island lying inside the box min [-0.016,-0.003,0.2204] max [0.016,0.035,0.314] (m)

Muzzle.rule: the front face: z = the minimum z; x / y = the centre of the vertices within 0.004 m of it

Sight.rule: the top centre of the pressure gauge: x / z = the bounds centre, y = the top of the largest island lying inside the box min [-0.008,0.063,0.14] max [0.008,0.113,0.194] (m)

Fore.rule: the bounds centre of the front vertical handle: the largest island lying inside the box min [-0.024,-0.113,0.012] max [0.024,0.008,0.06] (m) (its own island once the stray thread is gone)

processing.markerNotes: Grip: the centre of the rear rubber grip sleeve (the firing hand wraps the lance there, its fingers on the brass squeeze lever underneath); Muzzle: the centre of the burner bell's mouth plane (the open bell's rim: the flame starts here); Sight: the top centre of the pressure gauge on the valve body, the model's highest point (it anchors the hip pose only: the weapon has no aimed pose); Fore: the centre of the front vertical handle (the second hand)

textures.note: Meshy's 2048 px map downsized to 1024 (sharp lanczos3, JPEG q90 4:4:4)
Meshy's 2048 px map downsized to 1024 (sharp lanczos3, JPEG q92 4:4:4)

texturePolicy: the model's own PBR maps kept slot for slot (base colour / metallic-roughness / normal): the 2048 px base colour JPEG byte-exact, the metallic-roughness / normal maps downsized 2048 -> 1024 px and re-encoded (no recolour, tint, re-texture, projection or new art)
limitations: one rigid mesh: the squeeze lever, the valve button and the gauge needle are modelled in place and do not move
the burner bell is an open cone with the nozzle modelled inside; its inner surface carries the reconstruction's own texture
convention: metres at real size, +Y up, the burner bell toward -Z, the right side +X; bounding box centred on the origin; empty marker nodes Grip / Muzzle / Sight / Fore
licence: generated for this project under the existing provider accounts; unapproved prototype asset, no blanket licence or commercial clearance implied (assets/CREDITS.md)
